verdict.line: You lose early trades and any pre-6 solo-kill attempt to Illaoi, but Gnar's kiting and scaling flip the game later, matching the measured 58.5% Gnar win rate over 65 games despite her laning edge.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) is a 4-second-cooldown leap that lets her stick to you and her passive Tentacles spawn on nearby walls and heal her whenever they hit a champion, so she wins short trades and holds the solo-kill edge early. Gnar's answer is range and mobility: Q (Boomerang Throw) out-pokes her 850-range Q, and E (Hop) lets him disengage her leap strings, which is why Gnar comes out ahead over a full game despite losing the laning phase.

theirWindow.when: She lands E near a wall
theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately — her Tentacles spawn on nearby impassable terrain and heal her on every hit, and if she's pulled your spirit out with E, any damage you deal gets echoed back onto you, so don't trade into it, just walk away and wait it out.

yourWindow.when: Her E (Test of Spirit) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and throw Q (Boomerang Throw) at max 1100 range for free poke; catch it on the way back to cut its cooldown (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) and keep repeating while she has no way to force a spirit-echo trade on you.

start.why: 49% win rate over 51 games and the majority pick (58.6%) — the extra HP and sustain from the potion are what let you survive her Harsh Lesson pokes while you wait for Q range to matter.

boots.why: 50.7% win rate and the dominant pick (82.1%) — the flat physical damage reduction directly cuts down her auto-attacks and Tentacle Smash damage during her all-in windows.

core.why: Gives Gnar the stats to actually kite once he's mobile — the highest-performing core path (70% win rate over 10 games) starts here.
Stacking armor shred turns your Q pokes into real damage against her naturally tanky, sustain-heavy build.
The tankiest finisher in the 70%-win-rate path — survives her W/E all-in combo long enough for you to disengage with E (Hop).

her Tentacle and Harsh Lesson healing is undoing your damage in extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking attack speed rewards staying on tempo with your Q resets and autos while kiting — pairs with the 53.8%-win-rate page, the better-performing of the two listed builds.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is both the most-played (74.2% pick) and best-performing (54.5% win rate) combo here — Teleport lets you play the defensive early lane patiently and still get back for the scaling midgame you're favored in. Flash+Ignite (40% win rate, 16.9% pick) underperforms, which lines up with Illaoi holding the early solo-kill edge — don't force a level 2-3 kill.

playing.title: Poke from max Q range
playing.detail: Throw Boomerang Throw (Q) at its full 1100 range whenever she walks up, and catch it on return to cut the cooldown further.

playing.title: Never trade into Test of Spirit
playing.detail: If she's pulled your spirit out with E, any damage you deal gets echoed back onto you — disengage and wait it out instead of fighting.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassable terrain that heal her on every champion hit, so back off from walls the moment she commits to an engage.

playing.title: Use Hop to break her leap strings
playing.detail: Her W (Harsh Lesson) leap is only on a 4-second cooldown, so use E (Hop) to put distance between engages rather than saving it for an all-in.

playing.title: Time Mega Gnar's stun to punish her leap-in
playing.detail: Once transformed, W (Wallop) stuns an area in front of you — hold it for the moment she leaps in with Harsh Lesson rather than using it preemptively.

playing.title: Play for farm, not kills, before 6
playing.detail: Illaoi holds the lane and solo-kill edge pre-level 6 — prioritize safe CS and poke damage over forcing an early fight.

playing.title: Itemize against her sustain once it stalls your poke
playing.detail: If her Tentacle and Harsh Lesson healing is keeping her in lane too long, pivot a core slot toward Thornmail or Executioner's Calling.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — why each trade pattern and timing works — is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (E) while using [Q] to poke and gain control over lane. Do not let her push lane by clearing lane.
